svg.title: Amiel Catado: software developer, automation builder, data & reporting analyst
svg.desc: Less busywork. Fewer manual steps. More hours back. I’m Amiel, a developer who builds apps, automations and reports around how your team actually works, then shows you exactly what they saved.
